text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The Japan Cup... It's about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Every single runner is truly talented.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It looks like a lot of our Senior Class 
upperclassmen are running as well.
choice_data_list:
Let's challenge them with everything we've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even if it's just to correct my 
course... I cannot concede this path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Eishin Flash pumped herself up, 
something else on my mind as her Trainer 
was bothering me...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... Spe-san, I'm looking forward to 
working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the pleasure is mine! I look forward 
to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, Spe and Rob Roy are in this! 
Haven't they been out of racing for a 
while?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After racking up all those results 
before, it's been a while since my last 
race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
And prepare to be amazed! Both of them won 
their previous Japan Cups.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Rob Roy's unwavering determination has 
earned her a devoted following, and Spe's 
running is so strong, so powerful... she 
treats us to truly breathtaking victories!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ Talk about experience, she's 
completely in a league of her own.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it'll be a tough battle for 
a Classic-year girl...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is quite noisy, isn't it? But...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I shall do what I must. A run that won't 
fall behind the seniors...!
